name: Chromium Rhuell
description: Chromium Rhuell is a metallic-scaled elder dragon and scholar of creatures who sometimes takes human form to observe humans.

status.text: The last event shows Chromium Rhuell flying away after rebuking Nicol, and a later page calls him a surviving elder dragon.

timeline.summary: In the vision, a blind great shadow beats its wings and drops egg-stones from which dragons wake, as Arcades Sabboth, Chromium Rhuell and Palladia-Mors name themselves.
timeline.quote: By naming itself it takes control of its own destiny.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Two large egg-stones crack into the ground without waking, and Palladia-Mors dismisses them as weak and goes hunting.
timeline.quote: These two were too weak to wake up. Good riddance.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the twins meet Chromium Rhuell by a lake, who dismisses them and sends them to Palladia-Mors.
timeline.quote: But for now, go away, little ones.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ugin and Nicol wait on the birth mountain overnight and see a lone traveler who proves to be Chromium Rhuell in human form.
timeline.quote: who appeared outwardly as a pregnant human except for the way his eyes shone like sapphires

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Chromium Rhuell describes the dragon-killing chief and his heirs and proposes destroying them; Nicol twists his words.
timeline.quote: My recommendation is that we destroy the chief, his heirs, and his acolytes, burn all the temples, and salt the fields.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Chromium Rhuell, enraged by Nicol's twisting of words, reveals his true dragon form, belittles Nicol as the least of them, and flies away.
timeline.quote: You are the least of us, last fallen, not even a whole dragon but only half of one, bound as you are to Ugin.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Dakkon stabs Piru with the Blackblade, killing her; the blast creates the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor and Dihada absorbs Piru's soul power.
timeline.quote: he stabbed Piru with the Blackblade, killing her.

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "Geyadrone's plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chromium is spawned by the Ur-Dragon and learns to shapeshift into human form.
timeline.quote: he taught himself to shapeshift into a human form

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chromium hides among humans during the Elder Dragon War and survives.
timeline.quote: he was one of the few survivors of the War

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Elder Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon fights Chromium and Piru for Dihada; Chromium drains Dakkon, who teleports him away and then kills Piru with the Black Blade.
timeline.quote: Dakkon was reunited with the Black Blade and used it to kill the dragon

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Serving Dihada". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vaevictis wakes Palladia, who rampages at Mors Ridge; Chromium and Ad'Amra put her back to sleep.
timeline.quote: managed to put the sleep-spell back on Palladia

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Ham, the Tickery Man". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chromium pledges to Faralyn and befriends Ravidel; Arcades Sabboth is killed by Kristina.
timeline.quote: Chromium once again pledged allegiance to a planeswalker

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Serving Faralyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon, Faralyn, Leshrac and Szat betray the others; Szat kills Chromium so they can escape to Shandalar.
timeline.quote: Szat killed Chromium, who was powerful enough to allow them to escape

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel fashions Chromium's corpse into the Planar Barge.
timeline.quote: Ravidel took Chromium's corpse and fashioned it into what he called a Planar Barge

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Planar Barge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon bests Sol'Kanar, banishes Chromium and kills Piru with the Blackblade, creating the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.
timeline.quote: This released a massive energy blast that created the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor .

citation.text: "Dakkon Blackblade", section "Blackblade-Dihada War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Betrayers escape the Shard after Chromium and Ravidel die at the Summit of the Null Moon.
timeline.quote: No planeswalker died, but the deaths of Chromium Rhuell and Ravidel proved enough to let the betrayers escape.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dakkon kills Piru in a blast that creates the Dueling Chasm; Dihada absorbs the dragon's power and marks Dakkon.
timeline.quote: Dakkon killed Piru in a blast so powerful that it ripped the group apart

citation.text: "Geyadrone Dihada", section "Dihada's schemes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat kills Chromium Rhuell with Dark Banishing and combat breaks out.
timeline.quote: Szat follows through with Dark Banishing , killing the mighty dragon.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel is apprenticed to the planeswalker Faralyn to escape the calamities threatening his people.
timeline.quote: his parents thought it best to apprentice the young magician to the planeswalker Faralyn

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon, Faralyn, Szat and Leshrac manipulate the planeswalkers into fighting; Rhuell and Ravidel are killed.
timeline.quote: and so was Ravidel

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Death and resurrection". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon battle erupts among the planeswalkers; Ravidel and Rhuell die and Taysir and Kristina revive Ravidel.
timeline.quote: Taysir and his lover combined their magic to bring Ravidel back to life

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Rhuell rebukes Nicol for twisting his words
relations.quote: I hear what you are doing, Nicol Bolas.
